summary: Forensic audit identifying scripted vs trained vs emergent behaviors in the CARL-DX prototype curriculum.

6DOF_EMBODIMENT.scripting_notes: Actuation primitives (WALK, TURN, LOOK, INSPECT, AVOID, RECOVER) are parameterized inverse-kinematic routines.

HOMEOSTATIC_INTEROCEPTION.scripting_notes: Energy/thermal equations update in real-time from torque, but target food beacon in Stage 1 was positioned by script.

GENERATIVE_SELF_MODEL.scripting_notes: Predicts next state and adapts ground friction estimate, but dream horizon and candidate action set are pre-defined.

EPISODIC_AUTOBIOGRAPHICAL_MEMORY.scripting_notes: In Stage 3, initial hazard episode was manually injected via store_episode rather than naturally acquired through unscripted crash.

ENDOGENOUS_AGENCY_AND_VETO.scripting_notes: Goal generator derives goals from h(t), but test 4 triggered the veto by artificially injecting 25 rad/s at tick 15.

AFFECT_BODY_LANGUAGE.scripting_notes: Head tilt and spine roll/pitch postures were directly commanded via set_affect_state in the test harness.

CONTINUOUS_EMERGENCE_DEMO.scripting_notes: Demonstration switched behavioral modes based on hardcoded tick boundaries (t < 15, t < 35, t < 48) rather than unscripted agency.

INTEGRATED_INFORMATION_PHI_PROXY.scripting_notes: Calculates Tononi-Sporns cross-channel causal transfer on state time-series. Strictly labelled as Phi_proxy.

detailed_findings.description: Stage 0 partitioned into fixed tick brackets (t<15, t<35, t<48, t>=48) to showcase motor primitives in sequence.
External test harness explicitly assigned affect labels ('CURIOUS', 'EXCITED', 'CAUTIOUS', 'THREAT_AVERSION', 'SATISFACTION') rather than emerging autonomously from internal state.
Food position moved by test script to [0.35, 0.0] to guarantee absorption within 60-tick test window.
Negative hazard memory at (0.6, 0.0) seeded synthetically via store_episode.
Stage 6 emergence demonstration used hardcoded tick thresholds to sequence perception, locomotion, aversion, and satisfaction.

required_actions: Build fully closed-loop unscripted autonomous agent (carl_autonomous_agent.py) where internal state directly drives goal arbitration, Dreamer rollout, affect posture, and motor execution.
Implement Blind Emergence Test (run_blind_emergence_test.py) with ZERO tick-based branches, ZERO manual goal assignments, and ZERO external affect commands in an unseen environment.
Execute Paired Memory Causality ablation (With Memory vs Memory Ablated after experiencing real unscripted collision).
Execute Paired Self-Model Causality ablation (Intact Self-Model vs Degraded/Perturbed Self-Model).
Fix scorecard goal_reached vs verdict inconsistency.
